headline: Thursday's your only window; break has slid to the Flats
body:
Small-craft advisory is up for the outer waters and the Santa Rosa zone from 3 PM today through late Friday night — plan around it. Thursday runs light inside the triangle: seas near 2.8 ft, wind not filling past about 9 kn from the west until midafternoon. A workable morning. Friday stiffens hard — triangle winds climb to 17 kn gusting 18 by afternoon on 3.4-ft seas, and Santa Rosa Flats blows out at 23 kn and better than 5 ft. Scratch Friday.

The break isn't in the triangle. All three corners read warm today — west 72.5, east 72.1, south point 71 — with no 64–68 water anywhere inside. The coolest, cleanest edge is the south point in Santa Cruz Basin at 71, so start there and work south for any gradient. The real break has slid off toward Santa Rosa Flats, which only touches 68.1 on Friday — exactly when it's unfishable. So make no long run: Thursday it's 70.8 out there in 4.2-ft slop. Thursday morning on the triangle's south edge is your one honest shot.
